summary: Strengthen your community's resilience with our local capacity training. Learn essential strategies to empower individuals and promote sustainable growth.
lede: Community resilience training and capacity building help community development, humanitarian, and public-sector professionals strengthen local systems and prepare communities for disruption. Participants learn to assess vulnerability and institutional readiness, map community assets, and build inclusive engagement; they also develop capacity-building and emergency-preparedness plans and ways to monitor progress and sustain community ownership.
audienceIntro: This course is aimed at professionals who are dedicated to building, managing, or supporting community resilience efforts across various sectors.
audience: NGO program managers and field officers
modules: Building Emergency Preparedness and Response Capacity
Integrating Resilience into Ongoing Development Programs
Communicating and Advocating for Community Resilience
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of community development principles and some experience in working with community programs. Prior exposure to disaster risk reduction or capacity-building initiatives is beneficial but not required.
